```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# =====================================================================
# KAZA SSF — canonical base model (no elevation) + hydrological-year fits
# Standalone: loads the saved extractions from kaza_ssf.Rmd and fits.
# =====================================================================

library(tidyverse)  
library(here)
library(amt)
library(survival)
select <- dplyr::select

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 0: Load saved extractions (same folder for dry and wet)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
ele_trk_extract_dry <- readRDS(here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_kaza_dry.rds"))
ele_trk_extract_wet <- readRDS(here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_kaza_wet.rds"))

# Checks before fitting:
# 1. step_id must be id-prefixed (e.g. "AM105_12"), or strata collide across elephants
head(unique(ele_trk_extract_dry$step_id))
# 2. columns the script relies on
stopifnot(all(c("id", "t1_", "case_", "step_id", "aspect") %in% names(ele_trk_extract_dry)))
# 3. object class survived saving (should include "random_steps")
class(ele_trk_extract_dry)

```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 6a: Canonical base formula (team decision: linear, no elevation)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# aspect is circular (0 and 360 are the same direction), so it enters as
# northness/eastness instead of raw degrees.
base_vars <- c(
  "core_dist", "water_rivers_dist", "tree_cover_dist", "grassland_dist",
  "shrubland_dist", "cropland_dist", "urban_dist", "fence_dist", "road_dist",
  "slope", "northness", "eastness", "evi", "world_pop"
)

f_base <- reformulate(c(base_vars, "strata(step_id)"), response = "case_")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 6b: Prep — hydrological year, aspect transform, complete strata
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Hydrological year runs Nov–Oct and is labelled by the year it ENDS:
# Nov 2015 – Oct 2016 = HY 2016 (wet Nov–Apr, then dry May–Oct).
# Assigned on t1_, which used and available steps in a stratum share,
# so a stratum is never split across years.
prep_ssf <- function(data) {
  cls <- class(data)
  out <- data |>
    mutate(
      hydro_year = if_else(month(t1_) >= 11, year(t1_) + 1L, year(t1_)),
      northness  = cos(aspect * pi / 180),
      eastness   = sin(aspect * pi / 180)
    ) |>
    drop_na(all_of(base_vars)) |>
    # keep only strata that still have a used step AND >= 1 available
    group_by(step_id) |>
    filter(any(case_) & any(!case_)) |>
    ungroup()
  class(out) <- cls
  out
}

dry_prep <- prep_ssf(ele_trk_extract_dry)
wet_prep <- prep_ssf(ele_trk_extract_wet)

# Sanity checks: aspect should be degrees 0–360; check hydro-year coverage
range(ele_trk_extract_dry$aspect, na.rm = TRUE)
count(as_tibble(dry_prep), hydro_year, case_)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 6c: Fixed scaling (computed once on pooled data, reused everywhere)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Yearly coefficients are only comparable if every year is scaled with the
# SAME constants. Save these; the rasters must be scaled identically when
# building the resistance surface.
get_scaling <- function(data, vars) {
  tibble(
    var  = vars,
    mean = map_dbl(vars, ~ mean(data[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd   = map_dbl(vars, ~ sd(data[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}

apply_scaling <- function(data, sc) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sc))) {
    data[[sc$var[i]]] <- (data[[sc$var[i]]] - sc$mean[i]) / sc$sd[i]
  }
  data
}

sc_dry <- get_scaling(dry_prep, base_vars)
sc_wet <- get_scaling(wet_prep, base_vars)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 6d: Pooled base model (replaces m0 for resistance surfaces)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
m_base_dry <- dry_prep |> apply_scaling(sc_dry) |> fit_ssf(f_base, model = FALSE)
m_base_wet <- wet_prep |> apply_scaling(sc_wet) |> fit_ssf(f_base, model = FALSE)

summary(m_base_dry)
summary(m_base_wet)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 6e: Per-hydrological-year fits with sample-size gate
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# min_ids / min_used are placeholders — agree on thresholds with the team.
fit_by_year <- function(prep, sc, min_ids = 5, min_used = 2000) {
  cls <- class(prep)

  samples <- prep |>
    as_tibble() |>
    filter(case_) |>
    group_by(hydro_year) |>
    summarise(n_elephants = n_distinct(id), n_used = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(fitted = n_elephants >= min_ids & n_used >= min_used)

  keep <- samples |> filter(fitted) |> pull(hydro_year)

  fits <- map(set_names(keep), \(yr) {
    d <- prep |> filter(hydro_year == yr)
    class(d) <- cls
    d |> apply_scaling(sc) |> fit_ssf(f_base, model = FALSE)
  })

  list(samples = samples, fits = fits)
}

yr_dry <- fit_by_year(dry_prep, sc_dry)
yr_wet <- fit_by_year(wet_prep, sc_wet)

print(yr_dry$samples, n = Inf)
print(yr_wet$samples, n = Inf)

```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 6f: Coefficients across years vs pooled (answers "what varies?")
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
tidy_fit <- function(fit) {
  s <- summary(fit$model)$coefficients
  tibble(term = rownames(s), estimate = s[, "coef"], se = s[, "se(coef)"])
}

coef_by_year <- bind_rows(
  map_dfr(yr_dry$fits, tidy_fit, .id = "hydro_year") |> mutate(season = "dry"),
  map_dfr(yr_wet$fits, tidy_fit, .id = "hydro_year") |> mutate(season = "wet")
)

coef_pooled <- bind_rows(
  tidy_fit(m_base_dry) |> mutate(season = "dry"),
  tidy_fit(m_base_wet) |> mutate(season = "wet")
)

ggplot(coef_by_year, aes(x = hydro_year, y = estimate)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_hline(data = coef_pooled, aes(yintercept = estimate),
             linetype = "dashed", colour = "steelblue") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = estimate - 1.96 * se, ymax = estimate + 1.96 * se),
                  size = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(term ~ season, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Hydrological year (Nov–Oct, labelled by end year)",
       y = "Scaled coefficient",
       title = "KAZA SSF base model: yearly vs pooled (dashed) coefficients") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 6g: Save
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
saveRDS(list(dry = m_base_dry, wet = m_base_wet),
        here("outputs", "kaza_ssf_base_pooled.rds"))
saveRDS(list(dry = yr_dry, wet = yr_wet),
        here("outputs", "kaza_ssf_base_by_hydroyear.rds"))
saveRDS(list(dry = sc_dry, wet = sc_wet, vars = base_vars),
        here("outputs", "kaza_ssf_base_scaling.rds"))
```
